Context: 7. Retention of Quarters / Telephone

The facility of concessional retention of GPRA at the last place of posting is admissible only when the allottee is transferred to a place in NER, Sikkim, A&N Islands, Lakshadweep and to J & K from other places and not when repatriated back to his/her parent office in the above places on completion of their deputation. - Order A-3, Part-II, Appendix-9.
